Spell schools now come from Ars Nouveau's own metadata, and removing an addon fails loudly instead of silently changing a bound spell.

1.20.1.3.0.2: Affinity decay curve fix (~20x too fast), datapack tags for rings/blasphemies/source jars, Spell Loom advancement chain and screen readability, aura_failure_mode, config-driven progression curve.
1.20.1.3.0.1: Audit remediation: fixed uncraftable ritual tablets with Iron's loaded (item tag), config screen readability, Iron's-less boot crash fix, LP toggle gating.
1.20.1.3.0.0: Cross-cast inscription: export Ars spells onto Iron's scrolls and bind them into Iron's spellbooks via the Spell Loom.
